title: Red Hat Security Advisory: .NET 8.0 security update
description: .NET 8.0 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux contains security vulnerabilities including an out-of-bounds write in the Google Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497) and an elevation of privilege vulnerability in ASP.NET Core (CVE-2026-114148). These issues have been addressed in updated SDK and runtime packages. The update is rated as Important by Red Hat Product Security.
